audit_items.proof_trace: The close factor constraint is enforced unconditionally in `ensure_liquidate_borrow_allowed` (L1008-1012) via `float::from(liquidator_repay_amount).le(debt_balance.mul(close_factor))`, called from `liquidation_inner` (L722-731) before any repayment, and all three liquidation entry points route through `liquidation_inner`. The two bypass conditions (near-bad-debt at L988-992; min-value at L1006) are explicit, commented design decisions, not exploitable gaps. Post-check, the actual repaid amount is further capped to the ceiled debt balance (L734-743), making the actual close amount no larger than the checked input amount.
